item.title: 📆 Top News Today Crushing the enemy's rear: delivered strikes against power facilities
item.description: 📆 Top News Today 🎯 Crushing the enemy's rear: delivered strikes against power facilities , logistics and port infrastructure, as well as ships used in the interests of the AFU. 🤝 Road to life: the Yuzhnaya Group's servicemen evacuated nine civilians from Konstantinovka. One of the rescued residents of Konstantinovka described the cruelty of Ukrainian nationalists. ▫️ Taken aback : the Vostok Group's assaultmen mopped up an AFU stronghold in Zaporozhye region. 🔥 Flattened the shack : the Yuzhnaya Group's drone operators of the 85th Separate Motorised Rifle Brigade obliterated the AFU UAV control posts in Slavyansk-Kramatorsk agglomeration. 💥 A deadly 'surprise' for the enemy : the Tsentr Group's EOD specialists eliminated the AFU infantry by means of remote mining. 🎮 Had a ride – that's enough : UAV operators of the Vostok Group of Forces disrupted an AFU rotation in Zaporozhye region. The day is done, the tasks are completed. We keep working ▫️ #TopNews 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 💬 Hunting the vulnerable: odium and baseness of AFU militants One of the rescued residents of Konstantinovka
item.description: Hunting the vulnerable: odium and baseness of AFU militants 💬 One of the rescued residents of Konstantinovka described the cruelty of Ukrainian nationalists. ▫️ While the civilians hid in half-ruined houses and basements, the AFU deliberately attacked them with drones , trying to make their attacks look like the work of the Russian army. 'The AFU begins to stick red tape to batteries, Mavics, drones, like Russia does everything. And they burn houses,' the civilian told. ▫️ At least twenty such drones were lying around his house. Local residents saw all these provocations by AFU militants with their own eyes. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ▫️ Road to life: the Yuzhnaya Group's servicemen evacuated nine civilians from Konstantinovka.
item.description: Road to life: the Yuzhnaya Group's servicemen evacuated nine civilians from Konstantinovka. ▫️ First, the group was led along cleared paths under drone protection. When the weather turned, servicemen of the 78th Sever-Akhmat Regiment came out to meet them: the elderly were supported by the arm, and when their strength ran out, fighters carried them on their backs. 'Ali carried an old lady 15 km on his back. Through mud like that. They are iron men! We'll be praying for them for the rest of our lives,' one of the evacuees shares. 🤝 The final part of the journey they finished on an Ulan ATV, and safely reached a temporary accommodation. The worst is now behind – these people are safe and warm. ▫️ And our lads head out for another task – they are needed in the city. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/30746

Road to life:
the Yuzhnaya Group's servicemen evacuated nine civilians from Konstantinovka.
▫️
First, the group was led along cleared paths under drone protection. When the weather turned, servicemen of the 78th Sever-Akhmat Regiment came out to meet them:
the elderly were supported by the arm, and when their strength ran out, fighters carried them on their backs.
'Ali carried an old lady 15 km on his back. Through mud like that. They are iron men!
We'll be praying for them for the rest of our lives,' one of the evacuees shares.
🤝
The final part of the journey they finished on an Ulan ATV, and safely reached a temporary accommodation.
The worst is now behind – these people are safe and warm.
▫️
And our lads head out for another task – they are needed in the city.
🔹
Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ❗️ The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
item.description: ❗️ The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation. ↗️ The units of the Sever Group of Forces improved the tactical situation. They inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of one mechanised brigade, two assault regiments of the AFU, and one national guard brigade close to Veseloye, Makarovo, Ploskoye, and Golubovka (Kharkov region). 💥 In Sumy region, formations of three mechanised brigades, one airmobile brigade of the AFU, and one territorial defence brigade have been hit near Spasskoye, Pushkarevka, Vakalovshchina, Simonovka, and Novaya Sloboda (Sumy region). ▪️ The AFU losses amounted to up to 160 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, 12 motor vehicles, one electronic reconnaissance station, and nine counter-fire and electronic warfare stations. ⏩ The Zapad Group of Forces improved the situation along the front line. Russian troops engaged manpower and hardware of one mechanised brigade, one assault brigade of the AFU and two territorial defence brigades near Peski-Radkovskiye, Khomino (Kharkov region), Raygorodok, and Mayaki (Donetsk People's Republic). ▪️ The AFU losses amounted to more than 220 troops, one field artillery gun, and nine motor vehicles. ↗️ The Yuzhnaya Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions. The Group's elements engaged formations of four mechanised brigades, two airmobile brigades, and one assault regiment of the AFU close to Nikolayevka, Druzhkovka, and Belenkoye (Donetsk People's Republic). ▪️ T
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/30744

❗️
The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
↗️
The units of the Sever Group of Forces improved the tactical situation.
They inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of one mechanised brigade, two assault regiments of the AFU, and one national guard brigade close to Veseloye, Makarovo, Ploskoye, and Golubovka (Kharkov region).
💥
In Sumy region,
formations of three mechanised brigades, one airmobile brigade of the AFU, and one territorial defence brigade have been hit near Spasskoye, Pushkarevka, Vakalovshchina, Simonovka, and Novaya Sloboda (Sumy region).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to up to 160 troops, one armoured fighting vehicle, 12 motor vehicles, one electronic reconnaissance station, and nine counter-fire and electronic warfare stations.
⏩
The Zapad Group of Forces improved the situation along the front line.
Russian troops engaged manpower and hardware of one mechanised brigade, one assault brigade of the AFU and two territorial defence brigades near Peski-Radkovskiye, Khomino (Kharkov region), Raygorodok, and Mayaki (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 220 troops, one field artillery gun, and nine motor vehicles.
↗️
The Yuzhnaya Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions.
The Group's elements engaged formations of four mechanised brigades, two airmobile brigades, and one assault regiment of the AFU close to Nikolayevka, Druzhkovka, and Belenkoye (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The AFU lost more than 175 troops, four armoured fighting vehicles, 22 motor vehicles, and three electronic warfare stations.
📍
The Tsentr Group's units continued to carry out active offensive operations.
Strikes were delivered at manpower and hardware of three mechanised brigades, one infantry fighting brigade of the AFU, and two national guard brigades near Rayskoye, Viktorovka, Mikhaylovka, Novopavlovka, Sergeyevka, Kamenka and Ocheretino (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to up to 340 troops, four armoured fighting vehicles, one artillery gun, ten motor vehicles, and five electronic warfare stations.
👉
